Final for Publication

17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 1147-51 South Independence Boulevard
Proposed Zoning: _C1-2 Neighborhood Commercial District
Lot Area: Approximately 21,875 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is seeking to establish a uniform zoning district, maintain the
existing car wash and commercial building at 1151 South Independence
Boulevard, and develop 1147 South Independence Boulevard with four (4)
off-street parking spaces to serve the existing car wash. The existing car
wash and one-story commercial building at 1151 South Independence
Boulevard will remain without change. The subject property is a Transit
Served Location and will be supported by sixteen (16) off-street parking
spaces. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0300 optional Administrative Adjustment
and Variation the Applicant is seeking all zoning relief, as needed and as
allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plan.

(A) The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 3,215 square feet (0.19 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): No residential units proposed

(C) The amount of off-street parking: 16 parking spaces

() — Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: 28 feet (existing)
b. Side Setbacks:
North Side: 33 feet (existing)
South Side: 49 feet-8 inches (existing)
c. Rear Setback: AO feet (existing)

(E) Building Height: 22 feet-9 inches (existing)
